text: Human Powered Health is a US healthcare company and a subsidiary of Optum, which is itself part of UnitedHealth Group.
short: Human Powered Health is a subsidiary of Optum, part of UnitedHealth Group.

source.name: The Inner Ring: Women's Pro Team Sponsors Explained
source.quote: a subsidiary of Optum which is itself part of UnitedHealth group, the American health and insurance giant
source.note: The full sentence describes Human Powered Health as 'a US healthcare company that specialises helping to promote athletic health, offering nutritional advice and VO2 max testing for example and a subsidiary of Optum which is itself part of UnitedHealth group, the American health and insurance giant.'
